name: Hallstatt-Dachstein / Salzkammergut Cultural Landscape
description: In Austria's Salzkammergut region, the lakeside town of Hallstatt sits squeezed between the Hallstätter See and the steep Dachstein mountains. Salt has been mined here since the 2nd millennium BC, and the wealth it brought built the town's handsome houses. The site gave its name to the Early Iron Age Hallstatt culture, which dates to roughly 800–450 BC.
